notes.title: Player feedback update v1
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. The photographer has been well received after the release. I feel very honored.
According to your comments, I will gradually update and improve the photographer.
Some of the contents of this open update are as follows:
[olist]
[*] add skin color setting 
[*] add the main light direction and color setting
[*] add dynamic cloth test
[*] adjusted item generation position
[/olist]
Thank you again for your support. I hope you can leave more messages.
